info.name: NFON Call History Accounts records API
Get, stream, and search call records

params.name: search
params.description: Search the records. The search looks at the caller and callee names and numbers. Any other call record fields are currently not considered when searching

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter call records that match certain property values.

It is possible to specify multiple filters by providing a comma separated list. In this case only records that match all filters will be returned in the result.

For compatibility reasons, the `customer` and `extension` filters are treated as separate query parameters.

params.name: customer
params.description: The K-number for which to return call records. Applies only to admin level access with appropriate permissions

params.name: extension
params.description: The extension (user) for which to return call records. Applies to admin level access with appropriate permissions

params.name: from
params.description: Limit the list to records that are newer than this timestamp.

params.name: to
params.description: Limit the list to records that are older than this timestamp

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of call records in the result.

params.name: offset
params.description: Generate the list starting from offset

params.name: complete
params.description: Should the records include the complete transcripts and summaries (for transcribed calls).

items.docs:
Get the latest call records. They can be filtered by number, name, time or type.

The response format is controlled by the `Accept` request header:

`application/json` *(default)*:

Returns a JSON array of call records.

`text/event-stream`:

Streams call records as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

Each event carries one JSON-encoded call record in its `data` field.
